    List.take m l

theorem ownLogGhost_campaign [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : s.role ≠ Role.leader → uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl ==∗ ∃
    k F, ownLogGhost γ id (pbecomeCandidate id s) none ∗ isCampK γ id (s.term + W64 1) F s.commit ∗
    isVlog γ id k (s.term + W64 1) false F ∗ logRecs γ base0 F ∗ ⌜PlogWf base0 F ∧ plogLast base0 F
    = plogLast s.base s.log⌝ ∗ voteEv γ id (s.term + W64 1) false F ∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ F =
    fp ++ s.log⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp ∗ commitIn γ F s.commit s.term

theorem ackAgree_full [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (b : entryID) (es fp : List EntryM)
    (t i : w64) : FullOk b fp → uint.Z b.index' ≤ uint.Z i → ⊢ ackAgree γ b es t i -∗ ∃ X, leadFull
    γ t X ∗ ⌜(plogTermAt base0 X i).isSome = true ∧ plogTermAt base0 X i = plogTermAt base0 (fp ++
    es) i⌝

    kl' : Option w64) : s'.log = s.log → s'.base = s.base → (s'.role = Role.leader → s.role =
    Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader → uint.Z s.term
    < uint.Z s'.term) → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∧ s'.term = s.term) →
    uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z s'.commit → KlStep s s' kl kl' →
    s'.commit = s.commit ∨ uint.Z s'.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl
    -∗ matchedOk γ s' -∗ (∀ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗
    commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s'.commit s'.term) -∗ (∀
    fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp
    s) -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp s')) -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s' kl'

theorem pleaderEntry_term (s : PState) : (pleaderEntry s).Term' = s.term

theorem snapOk_message [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) :
    PlogWfR s.base s.log → SnapOk id s m → ⊢ isCommittedIdx γ s.commit -∗ logRecs γ s.base s.log -∗
    baseOk γ s.base -∗ isCommittedIdx γ m.index ∗ isSnapMeta γ m.logterm m.index ∗ ⌜plogTermAt
    s.base s.log m.index = some m.logterm⌝

theorem bnd_le (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) : bnd s kl ≤ uint.Z s.term + 1

theorem ownLogGhost_learn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (ldr : w64) (q : GSet w64) : s.role ≠ Role.leader → ⊢ isWin γ ldr s.term q -∗
    ⌜s.vote = W64 0 → ¬id ∈ q⌝ -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s (some ldr)

theorem ownLogGhost_vote [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl ==∗ ∃ k F, ownLogGhost γ id s kl ∗ isVlog γ id k s.term
    kl.isSome F ∗ logRecs γ base0 F ∗ klOk γ id s kl ∗ ⌜PlogWf base0 F ∧ ∀ (x : entryID),
    plogUpToDate base0 F x = plogUpToDate s.base s.log x⌝ ∗ voteEv γ id s.term kl.isSome F

theorem vbnd_bnd (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) : vbnd s.term kl.isSome = bnd s kl

theorem cprefix_app (fp : List EntryM) (s : PState) (es : List EntryM) : uint.Z s.commit ≤ ↑(fp ++
    s.log).length → List.take (uint.Z s.commit).toNat (fp ++ s.log ++ es) = cprefix fp s

theorem ack_invs_insert [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s : PState) (kl : Option w64) (F
    : List EntryM) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (vlogs : GMap Nat ((w64 × Bool) × List EntryM)) (i
    : w64) : ⊢ hist γ F s.term i (bnd s kl) -∗ histsOk γ s kl F acks -∗ vlogsOk γ s acks vlogs -∗
    histsOk γ s kl F <[(s.term, i) := ()]>acks ∗ vlogsOk γ s (<[(s.term, i) := ()]>acks) vlogs

theorem ownLogGhost_ack [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (i : w64) (Hnc : s.role ≠ Role.candidate) (Hli : s.role = Role.leader → uint.Z i ≤
    plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log) : ⊢ ackOk γ s (s.term, i) -∗ (∀ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf
    s.base s.log⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ hist γ (fp ++
    s.log) s.term i (bnd s kl)) -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl ==∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl ∗ isAcked γ id
    s.term i

theorem hist_of_commit [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (c tm : w64) (B :
    Int) : PlogWf base0 F → uint.Z tm < B → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F -∗ commitIn γ F c tm -∗ hist γ F tm
    c B

theorem hist_replace [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F F' Y : List EntryM) (t i T : w64)
    (B B' c : Int) (k L : w64) : B ≤ B' → uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z T → uint.Z T < B' → 0 < uint.Z k → c ≤
    uint.Z k ∧ uint.Z k ≤ uint.Z L → (∀ (j : w64), uint.Z j < c → plogTermAt base0 F' j = plogTermAt
    base0 F j) → (∀ (j : w64), c ≤ uint.Z j ∧ uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z L → plogTermAt base0 F' j =
    plogTermAt base0 Y j ∧ (plogTermAt base0 Y j).isSome = true) → plogTermAt base0 F k ≠ plogTermAt
    base0 Y k → (∀ (j : w64), uint.Z L < uint.Z j → plogTermAt base0 F' j = none) → ⊢ leadFull γ T Y
    -∗ hist γ F t i B -∗ hist γ F' t i B'

theorem acks_add [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γa : GName) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (k : w64 ×
    w64) : ⊢ ghostMapAuth γa 1 acks -∗ ([∗map] k ↦ u ∈ acks, k ↪[γa]□ u) ==∗ ghostMapAuth γa 1 <[k
    := ()]>acks ∗ ([∗map] k ↦ u ∈ <[k := ()]>acks, k ↪[γa]□ u) ∗ k ↪[γa]□ ()

theorem ownLogGhost_mono [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : s'.log = s.log → s'.base = s.base → s'.commit = s.commit → (s'.role = Role.leader
    → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ s'.matched = s.matched) → (s'.role = Role.candidate
    → s.role = Role.candidate ∧ s'.term = s.term) → (s.role = Role.leader → s'.role = Role.leader) →
    s'.term = s.term → (s'.vote = W64 0 → s.vote = W64 0) → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ownLogGhost γ
    id s' kl

theorem cprefix_transfer [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (fp1 fp2 : List EntryM) (s :
    PState) : FullOk s.base fp1 → FullOk s.base fp2 → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 fp1 -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp2
    -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp1 s) -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp2 s)

theorem acksOk_upd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s s' : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 ×
    w64) Unit) : uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader →
    uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z s'.commit → AcksTerm s acks → ⊢ □
    (⌜s'.term = s.term⌝ -∗ ∀ i, ⌜uint.Z s'.commit < uint.Z i⌝ -∗ ackAgree γ s.base s.log s.term i -∗
    ackAgree γ s'.base s'.log s.term i) -∗ acksOk γ s acks -∗ acksOk γ s' acks

    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ⌜LogOk s⌝ ∗ logRecs γ s.base s.log

theorem replOk_message [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg)
    (fp : List EntryM) : PlogWfR s.base s.log → ReplOk id s m → id ≠ W64 0 → (γ.reDyn ≠ none → m.ty
    = MsgType.app → ConfI1 (fp ++ s.log) (uint.Z m.commit).toNat) → (m.ty = MsgType.snap → ∀ (T :
    GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → id ∈ T ∧ m.dst ∈ T) → ⊢ isLeader γ id s.term -∗ leadPrefix γ
    id s.term s.base s.log -∗ lpfull γ id s.term s.base s.log fp -∗ logRecs γ s.base s.log -∗
    commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ baseOk γ s.base -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp s) -∗
    isMessage γ m

    : Option w64) (i : w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ isAcked γ id s.term i -∗ ∀ x, ackAgree γ
    s.base s.log s.term i

theorem ownLogGhost_boot [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ ⌜↑γ.reBoot.length ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧ (γ.reBoot ≠ [] →
    1 ≤ uint.Z s.term)⌝ ∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ γ.reBoot <+: fp ++ s.log⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp

theorem ownLogGhost_inv [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ raftCommitInv γ

theorem ownLogGhost_upd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (kl kl'
    : Option w64) : (s'.role = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ s'.base =
    s.base ∧ s'.log = s.log) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader → uint.Z s.term <
    uint.Z s'.term) → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∧ s'.term = s.term) →
    uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z s'.commit → KlStep s s' kl kl' → LogOk
    s' → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ □ (⌜s'.term = s.term⌝ -∗ ∀ i, ⌜uint.Z s'.commit < uint.Z i⌝ -∗
    ackAgree γ s.base s.log s.term i -∗ ackAgree γ s'.base s'.log s.term i) -∗ logRecs γ s'.base
    s'.log -∗ matchedOk γ s' -∗ baseOk γ s'.base -∗ (∀ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log ∧
    TermsLe s (fp ++ s.log)⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗
    isCommitted γ (cprefix fp s) -∗ ∃ fp', ⌜(FullOk s'.base fp' ∧ PlogWf s'.base s'.log ∧ TermsLe s'
    (fp' ++ s'.log)) ∧ (s'.role ≠ Role.follower → fp' ++ s'.log = fp ++ s.log)⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0
    fp' ∗ commitIn γ (fp' ++ s'.log) s'.commit s'.term ∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp' s') ∗ □ ∀ t i,
    ⌜uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z s.term⌝ -∗ hist γ (fp ++ s.log) t i (bnd s kl) -∗ hist γ (fp' ++ s'.log) t i
    (bnd s' kl')) -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s' kl'

theorem ownLogGhost_lead_full [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl
    : Option w64) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢ isLeader γ id s.term -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ (∃ fp,
    leadPrefix γ id s.term s.base s.log ∗ lpfull γ id s.term s.base s.log fp ∗ commitIn γ (fp ++
    s.log) s.commit s.term) ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl

theorem AcksTerm_insert (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (t i : w64) : uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z
    s.term → AcksTerm s acks → AcksTerm s <[(t, i) := ()]>acks

theorem vote_excl [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (γv : GName)
    (voted : GMap w64 w64) (ldr : w64) (q : GSet w64) : γ.reVotes !! id = some γv → VoteHistOk voted
    s → ⊢ ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) voted -∗ isWin γ ldr s.term q -∗ ⌜s.vote = W64 0 → ¬id ∈ q⌝

theorem boot_term_le [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (T : w64) : PlogWf
    base0 F → γ.reBoot <+: F → (∀ (j x : w64), plogTermAt base0 F j = some x → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z T)
    → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 1 ≤ uint.Z T⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_matched [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl -∗ matchedOk γ s

def KlStep (s s' : PState) (kl kl' : Option w64) : Prop :=
  kl' = kl ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ (s'.vote = W64 0 → s.vote = W64 0) ∧ (s'.role = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader) ∨
    kl' = none ∧ uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term ∧ s'.role ≠ Role.leader
